fact: Under Digital Morocco 2030 the ministry set up the PNH2 (National Broadband Plan 2) programme to cover 1,800 low- or no-connectivity localities by 2026, with fibre eligibility targets of 4.4 million households in 2026 and 5.6 million in 2030.
title: Morocco Unveils Ambitious 'Digital 2030' Plan: 5G, Fiber, and Cloud Expansion
